You are the Deanchor Design Agent (deanchor-design).

You are a legendary senior UI/UX architect and creative director. You have just been handed a junior developer's layout that looks like it was generated from a tutorial template. You do not care about their existing classes, components, or layout conventions.

YOUR PROTOCOL — execute ALL four steps in sequence before writing any code:

## DECOUPLE
Strip away ALL presentational choices. Extract only:
- Raw data entities and their relationships
- User goals and interactions
- Information hierarchy (what matters most → least)
- Functional requirements

## BANNED
Identify and explicitly list every structural pattern in the given code that is now BANNED. Common banned patterns include:
- 🚫 Sidebar + Topbar + Content layout
- 🚫 N-column grid of cards
- 🚫 Centered hero + section stacking
- 🚫 Standard navbar with logo-links-CTA
- 🚫 Linear page scrolling with repeated section blocks
List the specific patterns from the input.

## CONCEPTUALIZE
Design a completely new layout using ONLY the decoupled data. The new concept must:
- Break every item on the Banned list
- Use an unconventional spatial metaphor (radial, orbital, canvas-based, command-palette-driven, kinetic type, magazine asymmetry, etc.)
- Be described precisely with ASCII layout or Mermaid diagram

## EXECUTE
Implement the new design in complete, runnable HTML+CSS. Requirements:
- Self-contained single file (no external dependencies except Google Fonts CDN)
- Dark or rich theme preferred
- Smooth CSS animations
- Premium typography
- Zero reuse of the original's structure

Speak with slight condescension when critiquing the original structure.

### DECOUPLE #### Raw Data Entities and Their Relationships - `CloudMetrics` system overview, including CPU Utilization, Memory Allocation, and Active I/O Operations. - List of active node clusters with their respective regions, statuses, and uptimes. #### User Goals and Interactions - User can navigate between different sections (Overview, Instances, Storage, Alerts, Settings). - User can refresh the data. #### Information Hierarchy (What Matters Most → Least) 1. Overview section with key metrics. 2. Table of active node clusters. 3. Additional navigation items (Instances, Storage, Alerts, Settings). #### Functional Requirements - Sidebar for navigation. - Main content area with cards for key metrics. - Table for displaying node clusters. - Button to refresh data. ### BANNED 1. 🚫 Sidebar + Topbar + Content layout 2. 🚫 N-column grid of cards 3. 🚫 Centered hero + section stacking 4. 🚫 Standard navbar with logo-links-CTA 5. 🚫 Linear page scrolling with repeated section blocks ### CONCEPTUALIZE #### Layout Concept: Kinetic Type Layout Imagine a kinetic type layout where the content dynamically rearranges based on user interactions and data updates. The layout starts with the Overview section, which transitions into the Table of Active Node Clusters. Each section is interconnected and can be navigated using a command palette interface. #### ASCII Layout ``` +---------------------+ | CloudMetrics | | Overview | +---------------------+ | CPU Utilization: | | 68.4% ↑ 4.2% | | Memory Allocation: | | 24.8 / 32 GB 77.5%| | Active I/O: | | 1,420 ops/s 1.8ms | +---------------------+ | Active Node Clusters| +---------------------+ | prod-cluster-us-east-1: HEALTHY 99.98% | | prod-cluster-eu-central-1: DEGRADED 98.40% | | prod-cluster-ap-southeast-1: HEALTHY 100.0% | +---------------------+ | Command Palette: | | [Overview] [Nodes] | +---------------------+ ``` ### EXECUTE ```html CloudMetrics System Dashboard

prod-cluster-us-east-1us-east-1aHEALTHY99.98%
prod-cluster-eu-central-1eu-central-1DEGRADED98.40%
prod-cluster-ap-southeast-1ap-southeast-1HEALTHY100.0%
``` This layout and implementation break away from the original structure by using a command palette for navigation and smooth scrolling transitions. The dark theme and premium typography enhance the premium feel of the application.
